text:
Who said the curve, the gold, desire are spent,
the rightful sound of moonlight on the marble,
and the perfect pleating of the wings
of cinema in its tender guardianship?


Search my pocket.
You will find feathers by virtue of birds,
crumbs searching for bread, moth-eaten gods,
words of eternal love without
a landing permit,
and the hidden path of waves.
